summary: Frontend-only i18n Phase 1+2 verification. All acceptance criteria pass on both desktop (1280) and mobile (390). English default renders with no raw translation keys anywhere (auth:*, settings:*, common:*, validation:* absent). Login/Signup/Reset screens are fully translated in both EN and IT. Bottom tabs show Dashboard/Projects/New/Templates/Account in EN and Dashboard/Progetti/Nuovo/Modelli/Account in IT. Settings language toggle (testIDs lang-en / lang-it) switches the Settings screen AND tab labels INSTANTLY with no reload/logout (verified header 'Impostazioni', sections 'ASPETTO'/'LINGUA'/'ACCESSIBILITÀ', logout 'Esci'). Persistence via AsyncStorage key 'frameflow.language' confirmed: after a full browser reload the app comes back up in Italian. Switch back to English also works. Regression: theme (system/light/dark), density (compact/comfortable/large), and accessibility toggles (reduce-motion, high-contrast) all still work and Settings themes correctly in dark mode. Per phase note, Dashboard/Projects/Templates/Wizard/Editor body content intentionally remains English and was NOT flagged.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n/index.ts sets provisional lng='en' before LanguageProvider resolves; LanguageProvider gates first render on `ready`, which correctly prevents flicker. Good pattern.
LanguageProvider persists to AsyncStorage key 'frameflow.language' as spec'd and detectDeviceLanguage() correctly returns 'it' only for languageCode==='it'.

Every translated surface (login.tsx, signup.tsx, reset.tsx, (tabs)/_layout.tsx, (tabs)/settings.tsx) uses namespaced t() calls with proper namespaces (auth, common, validation, settings, navigation, errors). No hardcoded strings observed on translated screens.
Nit (non-blocking): settings.tsx SHORTCUTS array is rebuilt inside render each pass; fine at this scale, but could memoize on locale change.
